authoritative: Source: the Secretary of State's certified results by county, whose county rows add up to each candidate's printed state total; they replace Algara and Amlani's county rows.
title: Election summary for the 2000 general election, United States Representative District 5, certified results by county

pages.hint: Each county is a block with one line per candidate. Make each county one row and each candidate one column, in printed order, with the candidate's name as the header (votes only, not percentages), then a Total for County column.
